contract: Gated Lernpfad foundation expansion: 28 authored candidate lessons, goals first, canonical Joy, actual letter placement, bounded input, prerequisite help, suspended cursors and dated review. Automated/layout scope only; physical screen readers, native TTS, learner fun and approved mockup parity remain unverified.

renderedEvidence.observation: Goal and available activity count precede the next task; no full-band completion percentage.
German goal wraps at 200 percent text; no RenderFlex overflow in widget test.
Original canonical wing-open Joy follows durable completion; supported result, narrow scope and return CTA.
Catalog error retains retry and previous-path escape.

Two placed letter parts form the syllable above the submit action. The original wrong order remains in the response history; rearranging clears stale feedback. Submit advances only after durable save.

Scrolled to the two slots: selectable parts, rearrange, place and help controls remain readable at 200 percent German text. No drag is required. Physical keyboard and screen-reader QA remains pending.
The taught word, labelled entry field, check action and supported alternative remain distinct. A copied example does not become independent writing evidence.
Input label is outside the field and wraps instead of ellipsizing. Scrolling is required for the field at this text scale.

The prerequisite title wraps fully in the action, including an intra-word break at this scale. A scrollable choice dialog replaces the fixed-height dropdown that clipped the title. Selecting a different foundation displays its actual teaching.
Dated review begins at the new check without replaying teaching; its original independent receipt is preserved and validated. This is a delayed same-scope check, not proof of real-life transfer.

accessibility.evidence: Scoped automated check: Android 48dp tap guideline on teaching, actual Noto/Paperlogy fonts, 200 percent German reflow, reduced motion. Physical TalkBack/VoiceOver and complete audit pending.

responsive.evidence: Widget sizes 320x640 at 200 percent text and 390x844 at 100 percent; goals, input, preparation choice and letter placement reflow without layout exceptions. Captures inspected, including scroll positions.

loading.evidence: Delayed catalog future shows indicator then error/retry; widget regression.

empty.evidence: Empty record shows zero completion and unconfirmed skills; C2 selection creates no evidence.

error.evidence: Catalog retry, native rejected/uncertain write recovery, failed wrong-answer transition regression.

partial.evidence: Every band states incomplete curriculum; no total CEFR percentage or completion seal.

success.evidence: Actual path to lesson to receipt to path interaction; raw placement order, bounded input, help-before-use, delayed basis and per-lesson resume are tested. Supported results never become independent.

permission.reason: First lesson requests no microphone or new platform permission. Audio unavailable fallback tested; future microphone tasks remain under existing PhaseTaskScreen.

validation.flutterBreakdown: 20 model + 7 storage + 12 widget + 5 retained-evidence + 3 reset-zone tests; focused suites passed, widget suite rerun after final layout changes.
validation.staticAnalysis: Seven changed implementation/test files: no issues.
validation.review: Independent read-only review; prerequisite-help P2 fixed and rechecked, no new actionable assembly defects. Physical QA was not performed.
validation.exclusions: No device install, remote CI, user observation, pronunciation validation, complete A1-C2 narrative, cloud extension sync or public rollout.
